audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of 60 NPC romance, proposal, gift, greeting and preference-hint strings. Canonical Krobus and Club Card terms, male and female variants, slash branches, placeholders, dialogue commands, quotation marks and concatenated leading or trailing spaces were checked against the English source.
